item.title: An interview with Ondřej Surý, a volunteer who maintains PHP and automates its patches, about his role in fixing two critical PHP security vulnerabilities (Charlie Warzel/The Atlantic)
item.description:
Charlie Warzel / The Atlantic:
An interview with Ondřej Surý, a volunteer who maintains PHP and automates its patches, about his role in fixing two critical PHP security vulnerabilities  —  Ondřej Surý was a relatively anonymous volunteer working on PHP security.  Then the internet exploded.

item.title: German energy company PreussenElektra says it is working with Nvidia to assess whether the country's idle nuclear plants could be turned into data centers (Eva Brendel/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Eva Brendel / Bloomberg:
German energy company PreussenElektra says it is working with Nvidia to assess whether the country's idle nuclear plants could be turned into data centers  —  Germany's idle nuclear plants could find a new life as data centers, with operators looking for ways to redevelop the sites while dismantling of the reactors continues.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-22/germany-s-idle-nuclear-plants-eye-new-life-as-ai-data-centers

item.title: Microsoft says its GPT-5-powered Diagnostic Orchestrator uses agents that mimic panels of experts to diagnose conditions up to 4x more accurately than doctors (Robert Hart/The Verge)
